[EN] Bah! The wendigos don't scare me. If they were really that tough, we wouldn't still be here. I say, let them mount their attack and we'll let the ones still standing sort things out. Fates be damned!
[ES] ¡Bah! Los wendigos no me asustan. Si de verdad fueran tan duros, no seguiríamos aquí. ¡Yo digo que dejen que lancemos nuestro ataque y que los que sigan de pie resuelvan las cosas. ¡Que los hados se vayan al infierno!
